visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long light brown hair, wearing a yellow and white striped lace-trimmed top and several necklaces, speaks directly to the camera. The setting is an indoor room with a large white cabinet containing orange designer boxes and handbags visible in the background. Her facial expressions are expressive as she discusses a sensitive topic. (2) The scene shifts to a cinema lobby with checkered flooring. The woman is seated on a tall black stool, wearing a white cardigan and brown pants. She looks down and appears physically uncomfortable, holding her abdomen. (3) A close-up of a man wearing a black baseball cap and glasses appears; he pinches his nose and turns his head away with a look of disgust. (4) Back to the indoor studio, the woman points to her abdomen. A split-screen then shows a hand-to-hand exchange of a white and pink supplement pouch titled 'MezameLife'. (5) The woman holds the supplement pouch close to the camera, gesturing towards the ingredients and text. Detailed graphic overlays appear showing scientific charts, PACs concentration levels, and a 14-day clinical trial result graph. (6) Close-up shots of red Roselle flowers and a single semi-transparent supplement capsule are shown. The woman is seen in various settings—outdoors by a pool in a red and white floral top, and indoors in a white shirt—swallowing the capsule with water from a white mug. (7) The woman concludes the video back in the studio setting, holding both the product pouch and a white mug with a 'T' logo, smiling confidently at the camera.
